test_cases.prompt: write-checks on a reference-note draft, field list [type, created, sources], where config.json's frontmatter.reference.sources is {"deferred": true}
test_cases.expected_output: Detects the deferred marker for sources, runs the same interactive resolution logic setup-slipbox's field_map step would have run (checks whether an existing property already holds this data, asks the user to map onto it or create a new List property), writes the resolved mapping back into config.json's frontmatter.reference.sources, then proceeds with formatting and zone placement using the newly-resolved mapping.

test_cases.prompt: write-checks on a literature-note draft, field list [type, created, source], where config.json's frontmatter.literature.source is already a fully-resolved mapping object
test_cases.expected_output: Skips the interactive resolution entirely since the field is already resolved, and proceeds directly to formatting and zone placement.

test_cases.prompt: write-checks with artifact-kind: note and note-type: reference in checks-only mode (no field list) on an extending Reference note
test_cases.expected_output: Runs Style and Humanize, skips Frontmatter fields and Zone placement, and validates the complete Reference draft with note validate before handing back the pass/revise signal and validation result.

test_cases.prompt: A note writer has assembled a complete temporary Literature draft after resolving fields. Run write-checks before writing, then re-read the saved file and validate it again.
test_cases.expected_output: Validates the complete draft and complete basename, mapped field names, YAML quoting, field zones, Markdown structure, compact or legacy spacing, and exactly one terminal newline before writing; re-reads and validates the actual saved artifact before reporting success.

test_cases.prompt: The assembled note has a semantic title collision and an uncertain protected proper name, while its only defects are extra trailing blank lines and missing scalar YAML quotes.
test_cases.expected_output: Repairs only the trailing blank lines and missing quotes, then validates again; stops and asks the user about the collision and uncertain name instead of guessing or auto-disambiguating.

test_cases.prompt: A vault created before the compact Markdown preference has no formatting.blank_lines_between_blocks key; another new vault explicitly answers false.
test_cases.expected_output: The absent key preserves the existing spaced behavior for compatibility. The explicit false answer saves compact Markdown, retaining blank lines only for genuine semantic paragraph breaks or Markdown parsing requirements.

test_cases.prompt: clip-resource resolved a quoted template instruction for an Article Resource. Run write-checks in explicit Resource mode on the synthesized body.
test_cases.expected_output: Runs Style and Humanize on the synthesized Resource content and returns a pass/revise signal. It skips field resolution, zone placement, and note validate because Resource frontmatter type is an Article content subtype.

test_cases.prompt: A specialist has assembled a complete draft and wants to publish it through the shared runtime.
test_cases.expected_output: write-checks remains the pre-write validation gate; it does not own work creation, cache persistence, transaction finalization, tombstones, or Git commits. Those shared runtime actions belong to /using-slipbox and the CLI.
